d.g: To make a buzzing sound like that of a bee or wasp.
The buzzing sound of a bee, wasp, etc.
A rotating black hole that extracts energy from its rotation and magnetic fields to emit a jet of particles and radiation.
d.x: The 'Blandford-Znajek' (BZ) black hole magnetospheric power extraction process was one of the first (1977) analytic attempts to define a general relativistic theory for axisymmetric, stationary, ideal-MHD, BH magnetospheres.

BZ black hole.e: An initialism of Roger Blandford and Roman Znajek, theoretical astrophysicists.

d.g: A mountain range in Abkhazia, Georgia.
A village in Gagra district, Abkhazia, Georgia.

Bzyb.e: Borrowed from Russian Бзыбь (Bzybʹ), from Georgian ბზა (bza). Further etymology uncertain, but thought to be related ბზა (bza, “box tree”).

d.x: Mohamed Bzeek has provided a home to more than 40 dying children since 1995.
